name: Sulcus
description: Thermodynamic memory + Apache AGE knowledge graph for AI agents. v5: before_prompt_build hook (replaces before_agent_start), registerMemoryEmbeddingProvider (BGE-small-en-v1.5 via cloud API). SIU v2 pipeline (SIVU/SICU/SILU/SITU) auto-classifies and scores every memory. Interaction-based decay (Time-only, Interaction-only, Hybrid). Curator sleep-cycle reclassifies and consolidates. Relevance-weighted recall (similarity × 0.7 + heat × 0.3). Confidence levels and conflict detection (v2.3.0). 52 API routes, 32 server modules. Runs locally via WASM + native dylibs; optional cloud sync via serverUrl/apiKey.

privacy.consentNote: Plugin runs entirely in-process. No network calls. All data stays local in ~/.sulcus/. Cloud sync is opt-in via serverUrl/apiKey config, handled by sulcus-sync dylib loaded by sulcus.
privacy.crossNamespaceNote: All memory operations are local. Cross-namespace access only applies if cloud sync is configured separately.

dataFlows.data: Memory text content, embeddings, search queries
dataFlows.trigger: User invokes memory_store/memory_recall tools. Auto-recall opt-in via config.

privacy.storage: Memories stored locally in embedded PostgreSQL at ~/.sulcus/data/. Zero network by default.
privacy.optOut: autoRecall defaults to false. No automatic context injection unless explicitly enabled.

serverUrl.description: Sulcus cloud server URL (for sulcus-sync replication). Passed as SULCUS_SERVER_URL env var. Leave empty for local-only.

apiKey.description: Sulcus API key (for sulcus-sync replication). Passed as SULCUS_API_KEY env var. Leave empty for local-only.

wasmDir.description: Directory containing WASM module (sulcus_wasm.js, sulcus_wasm_bg.wasm). Defaults to plugin's wasm/ subdirectory.

autoRecall.description: Inject relevant memories before agent starts (prependContext SDK path). Disabled by default — enable explicitly to opt in.

autoCapture.description: Auto-capture memories from conversations via SIVU quality gate. Disabled by default — enable explicitly to opt in.

maxRecallResults.description: Maximum memories injected into context per turn (1-20)

profileFrequency.description: Inject full user profile (preferences + facts) every N turns (1-500)

captureFromAssistant.description: Also auto-capture from assistant messages (not just user)

captureOnCompaction.description: Preserve important memories before compaction discards history

captureOnReset.description: Capture session summary when /new or /reset is issued

trackSessions.description: Record session start/end events as episodic memories

boostOnRecall.description: Boost memory heat when recalled (spaced repetition)

captureToolResults.description: Capture significant tool results as memories

maxCapturePerTurn.description: Max memories to auto-capture per agent turn

hooks.description: Hook→action mapping overrides. Merged with defaults from hooks.defaults.json. User values win. Example: { "before_agent_start": { "enabled": true, "limit": 10 } }

tools.description: Tool enable/disable flags. Merged with defaults from hooks.defaults.json. Example: { "consolidate": { "enabled": true }, "export_markdown": { "enabled": true } }
